# Play

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Dark marketing site for a native iOS design tool: black page, mint primary button, TWK Everett headlines, four-column pricing, signed-out only.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public archive replays only; the live host did not resolve and no account was created). Themes: dark.

Play is a native iOS and macOS design tool (createwithplay.com). This package captures the public marketing site as it was archived, signed out. The live host did not resolve on 19 November 2026.

Surfaces: homepage, pricing, and download from January 2026 Internet Archive replays, plus the April 2026 shutdown notice. Themes: dark only. Widths: 1440 and 390 CSS pixels. No account was used.

The roles below are the catalog's swatches for the `dark` theme. The front matter then lists every colour token under `dark`, named by its path with dots turned into hyphens.

## Typography

15 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter, Inter Tight, TWK Everett Medium.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Where | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| TWK Everett Medium | Headlines | Commercial. Not committed |
| Inter Tight | Nav and footer labels | SIL Open Font License. Not committed |
| Inter | Body, prices, plan buttons | SIL Open Font License. Not committed |
| Inter Display | Segment labels | SIL Open Font License. Not committed |
| Fragment Mono, IBM Plex Mono | Declared `@font-face` rules, not used by the measured text | Not tokenised |

Fallback in tokens: `sans-serif` after the first family.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The computed styles and stylesheet declarations above were typed into tokens.json by hand and not saved: raw/ holds the capture notes and the unused Stitches names, not the readings. Every token is therefore labelled Reconstruction, entered by hand at capture time. A recapture of a replay should save the readings to raw/.

The pages are archive replays, not a live server. Wayback's toolbar was hidden before the screenshots. Some images in the hero are broken archive assets, so the lower half of the home screenshot is mostly black.

The green nav button did not change under hover, and focus left `outline: none`. That is what the computed style returned. It is not a designed focus ring.

`{border.default}` repeats the chip fill `#ffffff12` so the catalog border swatch resolves. The primary button's computed border width was 0.

TWK Everett Medium, Inter Tight, and Inter Display are commercial faces. The tokens name them. The style guide falls back to Inter.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the green only for the primary action.** The nav "Get Started for Free" button is `#17ffa6` on black, with near-black label text. [button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Keep the page black.** The marketing site paints `rgb(0, 0, 0)` and sets `theme-color` to `#000000`. [home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Set headlines in TWK Everett Medium, large, with tight tracking.** The January hero is 64px, line-height 70.4px. A second node of the same string used -4px tracking. [home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
- **Do not invent a login form.** The signed-out dashboard frame did not paint, and the April 2026 notice says new accounts are closed. [shutdown-dark-default.png](screenshots/shutdown-dark-default.png)
- **Do not treat archive hero images as the product UI.** Broken archive assets leave empty regions. Read colour from the tokens. [home-dark-default.png](screenshots/home-dark-default.png)
